description: USENIX's style file usenix2019_v3.sty (2018-12-19 revision 'for ATC'19', the file USENIX's paper-templates page links today), on plain article. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from usenix.org/conferences/author-resources/paper-templates. letterpaper, twocolumn and 10pt are its template's class options; without twocolumn the style tries \input twocolumn.sty, which does not exist. The style loads mathptmx, [T1]{fontenc}, [utf8]{inputenc} (ignored under XeTeX), pslatex, microtype [kerning,spacing] (pdfTeX-only features), flushend, cite, breakurl, url, xcolor and hyperref. breakurl, when not under pdfTeX, stops with 'The breakurl depends on hyperref package' unless hyperref is loaded first (breakurl.sty l.55-61), and the style loads it before hyperref. So the first preamble line marks breakurl as loaded and the last makes \burl a synonym of \url, which is what breakurl itself does under pdfTeX (l.38-53). microtype is loaded first with kerning and spacing off, and its option list then names the two, so usenix2019_v3.sty's \usepackage[kerning,spacing]{microtype} (l.30), which fails under XeTeX, is taken as already met (batch 2 probe; not yet compiled).
